chunks: Whoever performs more than fifty hajj is like one who performed fifty hajj with Muḥammad and the Awṣiyāʾ, peace be upon them. He is among those whom Allah, Mighty and Majestic, visits every Friday, and he is among those who enter Jannat ʿAdn, which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, created with His hand, which no eye has seen and no creature has looked upon.

There is no one who performs hajj abundantly except that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, builds for him, for every hajj, a city in Paradise. In it are chambers, and in every chamber is a ḥawrāʾ from the Ḥūr al-ʿĪn; with every ḥawrāʾ are three hundred maidens the like of whose beauty and جمال people have not seen.

key_terms.الْأَوْصِيَاءِ: the designated successors associated with Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم in this narration
key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise, the eternal abode of reward
key_terms.جَنَّةَ عَدْنٍ: the Garden of Eden, a special abode in Paradise
key_terms.جُمُعَةٍ: Friday, the recurring weekly day mentioned for divine visitation
key_terms.حُورِ الْعِينِ: the heavenly companions of Paradise characterized by beauty
key_terms.غُرَفٌ: elevated chambers or rooms in Paradise

ai.seo_question: What rewards are mentioned in hadith for performing hajj many times?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the immense reward of repeatedly performing hajj, likening abundant pilgrimage to performing hajj alongside Muḥammad and the Awṣiyāʾ عليهم السلام. It emphasizes the believer’s honor before Allah and the vast blessings of Paradise prepared for those who greatly increase in hajj.
